CustomField.description:
Appended the 7 digit IATA number with 1 in order to not lose the starting Zero from the IATA number for some, it also serves as a unique way to do lookups.
For Multi Numbers the M is replaced with 1 as well.
CustomField.formula: IF( Is_it_Multi__c = False, Value("1" & Agency_Number__c),Value("1" & LEFT(Agency_Number__c,3)& "1" & Right(Agency_Number__c,3)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 1 appended ahead of 7 digit IATA number for internal lookup purposes.
CustomField.label: IATA with Check Sum
